svg.title: The scalar contraction ρ of (FC15) is a reader on raw vectors that is constant on the fibres of the equation quotient: it kills E and the traceless conserved tensor w = (1, −1 4, 1), for which Div(w) = E, and hence the whole raw equation kernel. It therefore descends to the physical vector space. This is the scalar sensor used later, with sign and normalization fixed by (FC14)–(FC15): it reads minus the trace in units of Q = 1 4 P i,j⟨Fij, Fij⟩. The classification itself uses simplicity of the color Lie algebra through (FC1) and does not use connectedness of the group; this is a hypothesis of the supplied construction and is retained. The coordinates (y0, y1, y2) ↔(w0, w1, w2) of (FC14) are an explicit inverse pair, so the divergence map from invariant symmetric tensors of weight four to raw vectors of weight five is a bijection, and the fibre of the equation quotient is the single line RE.
